title: Megurine Luka — Growing Unease〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Mafuyu is probably talking to her mom right about now...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I don't know what's going to happen, but I have a feeling that real change will follow.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (He came back for a second and went somewhere again...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I told her...!
I told my mom how I really felt!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's all right... You're going to be okay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I came here to see if she would...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Mafuyu... She really did choose to run.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm here because I happened to spot a certain someone coming and going just now.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I take it Miku's still with Mafuyu?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes. Until she has a chance to settle down...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Let's head back. We've done our part.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Where were you two just now...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Where Kanade was.
Mafuyu chose to go see her it seems.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we ask the person who was with her the longest?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to do more for others...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to be right by their side when they're in pain...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But... You can do that as a doctor, no...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But... I don't think I actually want to become one...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you cry and feel so sad.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want you to know how I really feel...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know you're not going to like hearing this, Mom, but I... I don't want to lose them...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't want to give up music, or not see them ever again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't want either of those things to happen...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She finally got to let out what's been pent up inside of her this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes... And our hope was that the person listening would at least try to understand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That girl... She doesn't know what's best for you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I apologize for raising my voice like that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll understand, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because you're such a good, kind girl who I know will do the right thing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To be fair, that's nothing unexpected...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I'm surprised that you didn't end up doing more.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Finding out that we exist on top of what happened would've only made things worse...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, her phone seemed at least be able to turn on. Do you think it'll improve?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't know. We had no time to ask about that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I doubt we'll be able to answer that right now. For now, she needs some time to settle her mind...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (The one thing we do know for a fact is that real change is happening...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But whether or not it's to her benefit...)
